# spoke_recovery_points (Data Source)

Complete bounded mock-v5 metadata for an exact parent, limited to 2048 retained entries. Reads do not execute jobs or capture backups. A denied, unavailable or incomplete observation fails. Outputs and backup contents never enter state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spoke_recovery_points" "example" {
  parent_id = "policy-example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `parent_id` (String) Exact job or backup policy ID in the configured environment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Scope-qualified history identity.
- `items` (Attributes List) Complete retained metadata, ordered by immutable identity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `attempt` (Number) Execution attempt number; zero for recovery points.
- `id` (String) Immutable execution or recovery-point ID.
- `revision` (Number) Captured job or database revision.
- `source_id` (String) Originating schedule or source database ID.
- `state` (String) Observed execution outcome or completed recovery point.
- `timestamp` (Number) Scheduled occurrence or capture time in Unix seconds.
